review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: CHI SIAMO ADENTIS Italia è un gruppo europeo di consulenza ingegneristica e operativa facente parte del Gruppo MoOngy. Presente in 14 paesi europei con oltre 9.000 dipendenti, abbiamo aperto, da quattro anni, la prima sede italiana a Milano e, vista la continua crescita, stiamo rafforzando e ampliando il nostro team con persone che condividano gli stessi valori della nostra società: AMBIZIONE, DINAMISMO e VOGLIA DI METTERSI IN GIOCO , il tutto in una realtà in continua evoluzione, nella quale le relazioni umane sono sempre al primo posto. Ruolo: Network Engineer Modalità: Ibrido Sede : Roma IL TUO RUOLO Siamo alla ricerca di un/a Network Engineer con consolidata esperienza nella gestione di infrastrutture di rete enterprise. La risorsa sarà inserita direttamente all'interno del team che gestisce la rete intranet del cliente e si occuperanno delle attività di conduzione, monitoraggio, troubleshooting e supporto evolutivo dell'infrastruttura di rete. Requisiti: Certificazione Cisco CCNA o equivalente. Esperienza di almeno 3 anni nella gestione di infrastrutture di rete enterprise. Esperienza operativa su tecnologie Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet/FortiGate, HPE Networking, Cisco Nexus e F5 . Solida esperienza nella gestione di interconnessioni tra Data Center , con particolare focus su Cisco Nexus e F5 . Esperienza nella configurazione e gestione di Firewall Palo Alto , con competenze su: NAT, VPN, Routing, Troubleshooting Ottima conoscenza dei protocolli di routing: OSPF, BGP, Static Routing, Autonomous System (AS), eBGP Capacità di gestire scenari BGP complessi, con conoscenza delle tecniche di ottimizzazione del traffico: Traffico in uscita: Local Preference, Weight (Cisco), AS Path. Traffico in entrata: AS Path Prepending, MED, Community. Ottima conoscenza delle tecnologie Layer 2: VLAN, Access Port, Trunk, Campus Network Conoscenza approfondita dello Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) : Funzionamento e prevenzione dei loop Layer 2. Stati del protocollo: Blocking, Listening, Learning, Forwarding, Disabled. Conoscenza di RSTP (Rapid Spanning Tree) e MST (Multiple Spanning Tree) : Differenze tra STP, RSTP e MST. Meccanismi di convergenza rapida di RSTP. Configurazione di VLAN e istanze MST. Esperienza nella gestione di infrastrutture Wireless Enterprise , con competenze su: Wireless LAN Controller (WLC), Access Point, Comunicazione AP ↔ Controller, Central Switching, Local Switching (Bridge Mode), Vantaggi e limiti delle diverse modalità di gestione del traffico wireless. Esperienza nella configurazione e gestione di FortiGate , incluse: Configurazione firewall, Gestione delle policy, Conoscenza delle differenze tra FortiGate, WatchGuard e Palo Alto . Esperienza avanzata su Cisco Nexus , inclusa la configurazione di cluster e conoscenza di VXLAN . Esperienza su piattaforme F5 BIG-IP , con competenze in: Load Balancing, Configurazione di Virtual Server. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata. Cosa offriamo? Supporto tecnico specialistico da parte del team senior qualora necessario. Percorso di crescita professionale strutturato. Formazione continua su competenze tecniche e trasversali. Ambiente dinamico e altamente qualificato. La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 32.000 EUR e 38.000 EUR. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna The world needs you ADENTIS Italia è un equal opportunities employer: crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Ci impegniamo a garantire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni singola risorsa possa apportare un valore unico alla nostra realtà. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile. Inoltre, teniamo fede ai nostri impegni prestando attenzione alle risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99. I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel regolamento UE 2016/679.

You’ll take ownership of IT operations at AutoProff while working closely with the AutoScout24 Employee Tech team in Munich. It’s a broad, hands-on role covering daily IT operations and support, as well as migration projects and improvements to our IT setup. We’re always looking for better ways of doing things, so simplifying processes, automating recurring tasks and fixing issues at their root cause will also be part of the job. Maintain local IT stock, ensure equipment is available when needed. Some limited travel to other company locations and AutoScout24’s HQ in Munich should be expected. What we’re looking for A relevant IT education or vocational/apprenticeship background. 4+ years of experience in IT administration, support or a similar role. Solid experience with IT systems, networks, system security and IT administration. Experience supporting Windows and macOS in an enterprise environment. Experience with Jamf, Intune, Microsoft 365 and Azure AD. Knowledge of Identity & Access Management, including AD, SSO and MFA, ideally with Okta. Knowledge of network technologies including routers, VPN and Wi-Fi, ideally with Cisco. Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation. Strong problem-solving and communication skills. Fluency in Danish and English. We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across many different types of tasks and projects and comfortable working in an informal, dynamic and agile environment, and you combine a strong service mindset with the ability to take ownership and prioritise your work independently. You’re also someone who stays calm when something goes wrong, and you combine a strong service mindset with the ability to take ownership and prioritise your work independently. Why join AutoProff? At AutoProff, you’ll become part of an international company that is changing the way used cars are traded across Europe. You’ll work with colleagues across countries and functions in an environment where there is room to take ownership, share ideas and influence how we do things. In August 2022, AutoScout24, one of Europe’s leading online automotive marketplaces, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. Together, we are working towards creating a fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C solution for used cars across Europe. Our ambition is simple: to be the home of B2B car trading for European car dealers.

review_candidates.title: Information Technology Operations Specialist
review_candidates.description: Vil du være med til at sikre stabil og sikker IT-drift i et hybridt IT-miljø – og samtidig være med til at udvikle måden, der drives IT på? Actief Hartmanns søger for Kredsløb A/S en erfaren IT Operations Specialist, der motiveres af at skabe stabilitet, struktur og høj kvalitet i den daglige IT-drift. Du får en central rolle i et hybridt setup, hvor du arbejder på tværs af hostede/on-prem miljøer og Microsoft Azure og bliver en vigtig del af arbejdet med at sikre, at IT-services fungerer stabilt og sikkert. Rollen er for dig, der både trives med den daglige drift og med at finde ud af, hvorfor tingene sker – og hvordan vi undgår, at de sker igen. Dit ansvar Du får et bredt ansvar for den tekniske drift og for løbende at styrke vores driftssetup. Du kommer blandt andet til at: Sikre stabil og sikker drift af IT-platforme på tværs af on-prem/hostede miljøer og Azure Overvåge services og håndtere driftsforstyrrelser Fejlsøge og løse komplekse tekniske problemer på 2nd/3rd line-niveau Håndtere Incident, Problem og Change Management struktureret i et ITSM/ITIL-setup Sikre hurtig genoprettelse af services og arbejde systematisk med at forebygge gentagne fejl Arbejde med backup, patching, hardening og adgangsstyring Udarbejde og vedligeholde dokumentation, runbooks og driftsprocedurer Bidrage til standardisering, automatisering og løbende forbedringer af driften Samarbejde tæt med interne kolleger, forretningen og eksterne leverandører Følge op på leverancer og SLA'er i en leverandørstyret driftsmodel Du bliver dermed ikke kun en, der holder driften kørende. Du får også mulighed for at være med til at skabe et mere standardiseret, dokumenteret og robust driftsmiljø. Vi forestiller os, at du har minimum 5 års erfaring med IT Operations eller infrastruktur og er vant til at arbejde i komplekse driftsmiljøer. Det er et krav, at du har væsentlig praktisk erfaring med Azure Infrastruktur og Azure drift/operations-opgaver. Herunder også erfaring med deployment af Azure-infrastruktur- og servicekomponenter – både via GUI og IaC. Vi forventer, at du har erfaring med: Azure Infrastruktur og Azure drift/operations IT-drift i et hybridt miljø med on-prem/hostede miljøer og Azure. Deployment af Azure-infrastruktur og servicekomponenter via både GUI og IaC. Incident, Problem og Change Management og gerne ITIL/ITSM. Overvågning, fejlsøgning og stabilitetsarbejde. Windows Server, Active Directory eller tilsvarende infrastruktur. Dokumentation, runbooks og driftsprocedurer. Arbejde med enten SQL-drift eller Endpoint Management – erfaring med begge dele er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det er desuden relevant, hvis du har erfaring med eksempelvis PowerShell, Azure CLI, Terraform eller Bicep samt Azure governance og monitoring/observability. Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er din praktiske erfaring, din tekniske forståelse og din tilgang til professionel IT-drift. Hvem er du? Du er typen, der skaber ro og overblik, når noget går galt. Du arbejder struktureret og disciplineret og ved, at god drift handler om mere end at få systemet op at køre igen – det handler også om at forstå årsagen og sikre, at problemet ikke gentager sig. Du tager ansvar og følger opgaven til dørs. Samtidig er du nysgerrig og vedholdende, når du skal finde årsagen til et problem, du ikke har mødt før. Du trives med samarbejde og kan kommunikere med både tekniske kolleger, leverandører og forretningen. Du behøver ikke være den, der fylder mest i rummet, men du er fagligt velfunderet og tør tage ansvar for dine vurderinger. Og så har du lyst til at forbedre driften løbende – hvad enten det handler om bedre dokumentation, standardisering, automatisering eller en smartere måde at håndtere incidents på. Du tilbydes Du bliver en del af et miljø, hvor stabil drift, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er i fokus. Du får en bred rolle med mulighed for at arbejde på tværs af både klassisk infrastruktur, Azure og ITSM og får samtidig mulighed for at sætte dit præg på, hvordan driften udvikler sig.

review_candidates.title: Senior TechOps Generalist
review_candidates.description: Seen this advert before? That is because we are continuing to grow! We are very excited to be growing our small and efficient TechOps team at Octopus. We aren't looking for standard IT support - we are looking for an ambitious, deeply knowledgeable and experienced TechOps Generalist to join our team, to grow with the rest of the company, and ensure we are doing so in a secure and safe way. You will be a key partner in defining what TechOps is at Octopus. We will be continuing to shape this team to provide world class support to our employees, building our way out of problems with engineering firepower and undertaking transformational organisational change. We don't just "fix" things - we automate them out of existence. For us, a Generalist isn’t about knowing a little of everything, it’s a multi-disciplinary role for someone who’s deeply experienced in many facets of Enterprise IT. Think multi-domain specialist - not Jack of all trades. What is TechOps? A more modern, more lean version of a traditional Enterprise IT team with around one of us for every 1000 people at Octopus. We cover everything from what most people would call “1st line support” all the way up to high-level strategic planning, and everything in between. We tackle big problems and the breadth of work is huge. Dealing with ambiguity is a key part of working in TechOps, and every day will be a new and exciting one, working on varying challenges across the company and keeping plates spinning. We have a cloud-first approach to everything we do. This allows us to scale quickly and focus on things where we can add the most value. No on-prem AD here! Roles that you might currently be in: Systems engineer, DevOps, Tech support, Technical support, Technical support analyst, IT support, IT desktop support, Systems Administrator, Network Administrator, Workplace technology, Solutions specialist, Solutions administrator, Systems manager, Support manager. What you'll do Provide delightful day-to-day technical support to all areas of the business, to ensure our incredible employees are able to do their job as efficiently as possible. Their problems are our problems Troubleshoot and fix a wide range of technical issues, from laptop faults and network issues, to account provisioning failures and SSO problems Collaborate closely with our Security team to ensure we strike the right balance between security, productivity and user experience Continually find opportunities to automate our processes and improve the user experience Empower our people to help themselves by designing and building self-service solutions Monitor and maintain all the tech in our offices around the world - networks, meeting rooms, printers, digital signage, CCTV, door access control Managing supplier relationships and the procurement process for SaaS and hardware Lead and manage complex technical projects with multiple stakeholders from around the business. Examples of some TechOps projects include… Rollout of, and migration to, a new identity provider macOS and Windows MDM migration Rollout of a new device trust and posture compliance solution The replacement of insecure factors like SMS with phishing-resistant factors Office fit-outs, including tech like network, AV, access control etc SaaS migrations for acquisitions e.g. Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace What you'll need We’re looking for people with at least 5-7 years of solid enterprise IT experience. The technical bar is high. While we use Okta, Kandji, Kolide, Zscaler, Meraki and HiBob amongst others, we care about your understanding of the fundamentals of key SaaS tooling, but we also expect candidates to have significant experience implementing and customising these tools for Enterprise environments, so if you’ve lived in Entra and Intune? Awesome! You’ll also need: Confidence in articulating and implementing your technical ability, particularly with enterprise-level SaaS tooling, customer support and automation. The ability to do this both with your peers and novice users is vital A team player - we don’t want people who vanish and come back with perfect, completed work. You collaborate and work transparently and can identify who can help you, or needs your help Rich experience and examples of scripting, using APIs to automating mundane and error-prone repetitive tasks To be comfortable with a huge amount of ambiguity and spinning a lot of plates all at the same time Experience working with multiple teams and managing multiple stakeholders Experience managing and deploying macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android at scale Experience administering and troubleshooting Single Sign-On (SSO) technologies such as OAuth, OIDC and SAML Deep experience with Identity & Access Management. You should be able to explain the nuances of SAML, OIDC, and OAuth , and have hands-on experience with SCIM provisioning Experience of designing and installing office networks - we use Cisco Meraki A conscientious approach to everything you do and a passion for doing the right thing rather than the easy thing Don’t think you check off every single box? We love hiring passionate people with a drive to learn. If you are an expert in some of these areas and are hungry to master the rest, get in touch and let us know where your strengths lie. Why else you'll love it here Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture . An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We won best company to work for in 2022, on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022 and our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits This role can be either fully office based in any of our major offices in Brighton, Manchester, Leicester, Coventry or London , or a hybrid of a few days a week working remotely and office based. Our salary bandings are between £65,000 - £90,000 depending on your experience. On a call with one of our talent team, it's something we always chat through, as we genuinely want to match your experience with the right salary. We're very excited to be growing our small team. We're looking for skills and experience to help shape and define the future of not only our team, but the wider business at a global scale. If you're reading this and grinning, please apply! There are huge challenges to tackle, and we need amazing people who are keen to get stuck in. If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you. Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic! Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone. Where necessary, we sometimes use AI tools to help with parts of our hiring process, like reviewing applications or assessing responses. We’re lucky to receive a huge amount of interest, so these tools help our recruiters manage that volume, not replace them. Ultimately, every hiring decision (for example, whether to progress your application or not) is always made by a real person in our Talent team. If you’d like to know more about how we use your data, you can reach out to us via email at talent@octoenergy.com. We’re happy to help!

Kraken is building a dedicated AI Compute and Infrastructure team to power the next generation of model training, inference, evaluation, and experimentation across the exchange. This team sits within engineering leadership and owns the infrastructure layer that lets Kraken run AI workloads with control, speed, reliability, and cost discipline. The team is responsible for GPU and accelerator infrastructure, cluster operations, scheduling, model serving, observability, capacity planning, and cost-efficient compute at scale. This is the backbone that allows Kraken to train, serve, evaluate, and iterate on AI systems in-house where it matters for privacy, latency, reliability, cost, or product differentiation. You will join a small, senior, high-impact team working directly with AI/ML researchers, platform engineers, security teams, and product teams. The mandate is simple: make Kraken's AI ambitions real by building compute infrastructure that is fast, dependable, efficient, and production-grade. The opportunity Own and operate GPU and accelerator clusters used for training, inference, evaluation, and experimentation, including drivers, runtimes, kernels, device plugins, node configuration, scheduling primitives, and workload isolation. Design infrastructure that enables Kraken teams to run models locally on GPUs where it is strategically and economically preferable, reducing unnecessary dependency on external providers and containing compute costs. Build and improve scheduling, orchestration, placement, quota management, and utilization systems across heterogeneous accelerator environments. Optimize inference pipelines for latency, throughput, reliability, memory efficiency, and cost using frameworks such as vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, or equivalent serving stacks. Partner with ML engineers and researchers to remove bottlenecks in training, evaluation, batch inference, online inference, deployment, and production debugging workflows. Build observability for GPU utilization, memory pressure, queue depth, saturation, token throughput, request latency, failed workloads, capacity pressure, and spend. Drive reliability, incident response, alerting, runbooks, and post-incident improvements for always-on AI compute infrastructure. Evaluate and integrate new hardware, cloud instance families, specialized accelerators, runtimes, schedulers, and serving frameworks as the AI infrastructure landscape evolves. Build tooling that makes GPU usage visible, accountable, and easier for internal teams to consume without needing to become infrastructure experts. Contribute to long-term architecture decisions that balance performance, cost efficiency, scalability, operational simplicity, and production safety. What You Bring 5+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with significant time spent on GPU compute, ML infrastructure, distributed systems, high-performance computing, or large-scale production platforms. Hands-on experience operating GPU clusters or accelerator-backed infrastructure in production or production-like environments, including scheduling, orchestration, utilization monitoring, and cost optimization. Strong systems engineering fundamentals across Linux, networking, storage, containers, Kubernetes, distributed runtimes, and production debugging. Experience with ML serving frameworks such as vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, TorchServe, KServe, Ray Serve, or equivalent systems. Proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, debugging, integration, and operational workflows. Practical understanding of performance tradeoffs across batching, concurrency, memory usage, GPU utilization, model size, latency, throughput, availability, and cost. Track record of optimizing compute costs while maintaining clear performance, reliability, and availability expectations. Experience building observable systems with useful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, and incident workflows. Comfortable working in high-stakes, always-on environments where uptime, throughput, correctness, and operational discipline are critical. Clear communicator who can translate infrastructure tradeoffs for researchers, product teams, platform engineers, security stakeholders, and engineering leadership. Nice to haves Experience at a frontier AI lab, hyperscaler, high-frequency trading firm, research platform, or high-scale ML organization. Familiarity with custom silicon or specialized accelerators such as TPUs, AWS Trainium, Gaudi, or similar platforms. Background in capacity planning, procurement input, reserved capacity strategy, cloud accelerator economics, or GPU fleet cost management. Experience with distributed training frameworks such as DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, FSDP, Ray, or equivalent systems. Experience debugging CUDA, NCCL, kernel, driver, runtime, memory, networking, or low-level performance issues. Experience with Rust, C++, Go, CUDA, or other systems languages used for performance-critical infrastructure. Crypto, financial services, trading infrastructure, or security-sensitive production infrastructure experience. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitenden sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten. Was tragen Sie bei? Als Systemingenieur (w/m/d) setzen Sie die technische und termingerechte Integration von Fahrgastinformations- (FIS) und Videoüberwachungssysteme (CCTV), die auf modernen IT- und Kommunikationsinfrastrukturen basieren, um. Dabei begleiten Sie den gesamten V-Zyklus des Fahrzeugentwicklungsprojektes. Dazu erstellen Sie funktionale Konzepte und begleiten die technische Umsetzung bei der mechanischen-, elektrischen- und SW-Integration der Systeme in das Fahrzeug. Weiterhin definieren Sie Use Cases bzw. Business Cases und erstellen Systemanforderungsspezifikationen auf Basis der Kundenanforderungen. Sie überwachen den Arbeitsfortschritt und bewerten das Ergebnis der Entwicklungsleistung im Rahmen der Entwicklung von FIS und CCTV-Subsystemen (interne/externe Lieferanten). Dabei sind Sie Schnittstelle zwischen externen Kunden und dem Lieferanten. Sie nutzen Standardkomponenten und projektspezifisch entwickelte Komponenten, deren Entwicklung Sie ebenfalls begleiten. Was bringen Sie mit? Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium der Elektro-, Nachrichtentechnik oder Informatik. Sie bringen mehrjährige Erfahrungen im Bereich Fahrgastinformationstechnologie (CCTV und FIS) mit. Sie besitzen gute Kenntnisse der Kommunikations-/Netzwerk-Technologien und Architekturen (z. B. LAN, Bluetooth, WLAN). Dazu haben Sie gute Kenntnisse in SW- und System-Architekturen und breit gefächerte Kenntnisse in der HW- und SW-Systemintegration. Idealerweise kennen Sie sich mit der bahnspezifischen Normenwelt (z. B. EN 50155, UIC 568, TSI PRM / LOC&PAS) aus. Ferner sprechen Sie sehr gut Deutsch und Englisch. Was bieten wir Ihnen? Inklusion & Vielfalt Bei Siemens Mobility setzen wir uns engagiert für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichberechtigung ein. Vielfalt bereichert unser Team und fördert innovative Lösungen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung. Mobiles Arbeiten /Remote Working Bei uns haben Sie die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten. Das bedeutet, dass Sie zu einem gewissen Anteil mobil tätig sein können. Dies haben wir durch eine Betriebsvereinbarung offiziell geregelt. Attraktive Konditionen Sie erhalten ein attraktives Vergütungspaket einschließlich der Leistungen des Tarifvertrages (z.B. Zusatzentgelte und Urlaubsgeld) und weiteren Extras (z.B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Aktienprogramm). Eine Übersicht über unsere Benefits finden Sie hier. Wie treten Sie mit uns in Kontakt? www.siemens.de/mobility wenn Sie vor Ihrer Bewerbung mehr über Siemens erfahren möchten. www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/faq.html wenn Sie Informationen rund um das Thema Bewerbung mittels unseres FAQ’s einholen möchten. +49 (9131) 17 5243-0 wenn Sie über unsere Bewerberhotline weitere Fragen zur Stelle klären möchten. www.siemens.com/mobility-jobs wenn Sie mehr Informationen zu Jobs & Karriere bei Siemens erhalten möchten. Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung. Ansprechpartner für diese Stellenausschreibung ist Frau Veronika Windmaier.

review_candidates.description: About Us Kumaran Systems: Engineering Future-Ready Transformations Since 1992, Kumaran Systems has been helping enterprises bridge the past and the future, reimagining legacy systems and embracing AI-led possibilities. With over 34 years of delivery excellence, we specialise in re-engineering core applications, driving cloud transformation, and building automation-first, GenAI-enabled ecosystems across the Banking and Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, and Automotive sectors. We help organisations not just upgrade their systems but reimagine what’s possible. Why Kumaran? We blend engineering discipline with AI innovation, helping clients modernise with confidence, automate with clarity, and scale with purpose. Our global delivery model ensures agility, responsiveness, and seamless collaboration, with clients always at the heart of every engagement. At Kumaran, we don’t just solve problems, we engineer future-ready transformations. Position Summary Seeking an experienced Operations Support Analyst to provide production support for mission-critical enterprise applications hosted on Red Hat OpenShift and Linux platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring application stability, resolving incidents, implementing changes, providing automation support, and continuously improving operational processes. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining high availability environments while collaborating with development, infrastructure, and business teams. Key Responsibilities Provide Level 2/Level 3 production support for business-critical applications in Linux and OpenShift environments. Monitor application health, system performance, scheduled jobs, and integration processes using operational monitoring tools. Support and troubleshoot Feed Hub integration services, data feeds, and related middleware components. Manage and monitor AutoSys jobs, investigate failures, and coordinate recovery activities. Perform certificate lifecycle management, including renewal, installation, validation, and troubleshooting SSL/TLS-related issues. Participate in application deployment activities using CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, UDeploy (UCD), UCV, and iDeploy. Collaborate with development teams to identify causes and implement permanent fixes for recurring incidents. Execute application releases and production changes while adhering to ITIL-based change management processes. Analyse production incidents, perform impact assessments, and ensure timely resolution within SLA requirements. Support platform stability, reliability, and operational readiness during maintenance activities and releases. Create and maintain operational documentation, support procedures, and knowledge base articles. Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours production support, incident management, and emergency change implementations. Work closely with infrastructure, security, database, and networking teams to resolve complex technical issues. Contribute to automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention. Required Technical Skills Platform & Operating Systems Red Hat OpenShift Linux Administration (RHEL preferred) Shell Scripting (Bash) Application & Operations Support Production Application Support Incident Management Problem Management Change Management Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Service Availability Monitoring Scheduling & Integration AutoSys Job Scheduling FeedHub Support and Monitoring Batch Processing Support Security & Certificate Management SSL/TLS Certificate Management Certificate Installation and Renewal Security Compliance Support CI/CD & DevOps Tools Jenkins Azure DevOps UrbanCode Deploy (UCD) UrbanCode Velocity (UCV) iDeploy CI/CD Release Management Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. 3+ years of experience in application production support or operations support roles. Hands-on experience supporting applications running on Red Hat OpenShift and Linux environments. Strong understanding of incidents, problems, and change management processes. Experience with enterprise scheduling tools such as AutoSys. Knowledge of SSL certificates and application security fundamentals. Experience supporting CI/CD deployment pipelines. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Key Competencies Production Support Excellence Critical Incident Management Change & Release Management Problem Solving and Root Cause Analysis Collaboration and Teamwork Customer Focus Operational Risk Awareness Ability to work effectively in an on-call support model

review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Job Own the reliability of AI compute hardware where lab discovery becomes data centre reality. Graphcore is building the hardware and systems infrastructure needed for the next generation of AI breakthroughs. This role helps prove those platforms work when complexity, scale and pressure increase. You will lead advanced operational, diagnostic and engineering support across lab and data centre environments. Your work will improve hardware bring-up, validation and troubleshooting for AI compute platforms. You will diagnose failures across server blades, racks, power systems, thermal behaviour, network configuration and BIOS/BMC issues. You will turn hard problems into clear root cause analysis, corrective action and better operating practice. This is hands-on engineering with visible impact. You will support new platforms from early bring-up through deployment, helping Graphcore move faster with confidence. The team and culture You will work with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, server engineering, firmware, platform architects and data centre operations. Problems are solved close to the hardware, with clear evidence and direct ownership. The team moves quickly during bring-up and validation cycles. Engineers are expected to act fast, take responsibility and speak up when something needs attention. Decisions are shaped by data, system behaviour and practical engineering judgement. You will guide others, improve documentation and help raise the standard of hardware diagnostics. What we're looking for Strong knowledge of server hardware architectures and board-level debugging Experience isolating failures using system logs, telemetry, power data and thermal metrics Hands-on experience with HPC systems, AI compute platforms or rack-scale infrastructure Ability to lead structured root cause analysis and propose practical corrective actions Confidence working across engineering, platform and data centre teams Clear written and verbal communication, with the judgement to guide junior engineers While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes. Benefits Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. Sponsorship Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role. Join the Team at Graphcore Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. If you want to shape the reliability of AI infrastructure at real scale, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to be part of the journey.

review_candidates.title: Junior Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: Intric builds a sovereign AI platform for organisations that need to keep their data close: public-sector bodies, municipalities and critical infrastructure. It’s a small team, which means the work is real, the decisions matter and you’ll get close to the systems that actually keep the product running. As the second person on the platform team, you’ll work directly alongside the lead on day-to-day operations, investigations and larger infrastructure projects. This is an early-career role. You won’t be expected to arrive knowing the whole stack, but you will be expected to have solid foundations, learn quickly and take on more ownership as your understanding grows. The platform is largely self-hosted and open source. Kubernetes, k3s, Helm and Argo CD sit at the centre of it, alongside Docker and Dokploy environments that still need to be operated and migrated. Around that are Vault, Tailscale, Terraform, GitHub Actions, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, S3-compatible storage, Weaviate and a full OpenTelemetry and Grafana observability stack. Parts are sparsely documented and some of the problems won’t have a ready-made runbook. The learning curve is steep. What You’ll Do Get hands-on with the whole platform. Learn how our managed, dedicated and on-premises environments fit together. Make changes to Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, Argo CD applications, Terraform and CI/CD workflows. Early changes will be scoped and reviewed closely; over time, you’ll be expected to drive routine work yourself. Take ownership of observability over time. Build a clear picture of what we can see across metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerts. Improve what’s missing, reduce noise and make incidents easier to understand. The stack includes OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Mimir, Loki and Tempo. Take on the day-to-day operational load. Triage alerts, investigate failing workloads, make routine configuration changes and verify that deployments and backups are doing what we expect. The goal is for you to handle documented and familiar issues without needing to escalate, while escalating unfamiliar or high-risk problems early. Turn repeated work into automation. If something has to be done twice, look for a way to make the third time safer and faster. That might mean a shell or Python script, a GitHub Actions workflow, a better alert or a proper runbook. Work across the application boundary. The workload is a Python and FastAPI backend with workers, RabbitMQ consumers and several stateful dependencies. You won’t be hired as a backend engineer, but you will learn enough about the application to follow a problem from ingress to API, queue, consumer and data store. Document what you learn. When the documentation runs out, go looking for the answer. Once you find it, leave the system clearer for the next person. Who you are You’re comfortable in a Linux environment and want to understand what the machine is actually doing. You understand the basics of processes, permissions, networking, DNS, HTTP and TLS. You don’t need to know everything from memory, but you need enough of a model to investigate when something breaks. You’ve used Git and Docker, and you can automate a small task in shell, Python or another scripting language. You approach problems methodically. You gather evidence, form a hypothesis, test it and explain what you found. You go looking for answers when the documentation runs out, but you don’t hide blockers or guess when the blast radius is large. You can move between investigations, operational work and implementation without losing track of what matters. You can fill in reasonable gaps in a brief yourself, while checking assumptions that could affect production. An infrastructure environment that isn’t built entirely around AWS or GCP managed services strikes you as more interesting, not more limiting. You might be a recent graduate or have built equivalent experience through projects, a homelab or early professional work. We care more about the foundations you have and how you learn than whether you already know our particular stack. Excellent communication skills are needed for this role because collaboration with the Forward Deployed Engineering and Product teams is part of the day to day work. What you don’t need You don’t need professional experience with every technology listed above. You don’t need to be a Kubernetes expert on your first day. You don’t need to have operated a production platform before. You do need to be curious, careful and ready to become independently useful faster than you would in a heavily layered engineering organisation. About Intric Europe's public sector is facing its biggest challenge in generations. A shrinking workforce must deliver more services to more people, and the gap grows every year. Intric exists to close it. We bring modern AI to the organisations that keep society running, and in doing so, we're defining how public services will work for decades to come. We value ownership, high standards, and thoughtful execution. Titles matter less than contribution. If you see something that can be improved, you take initiative. If something is unclear, you ask questions. If a customer faces a challenge, you lean in. We combine ambition with collaboration. We move fast, but we care deeply about doing things right. As we continue scaling across Europe, every team member plays a meaningful role in shaping both the company and the culture.

Dit ga je doen Als Support Engineer bij PQR ben je verantwoordelijk voor het oplossen van incidenten bij onze klanten. Je handelt zowel eerste- als tweedelijns incidenten af, variërend van hardware- en softwarestoringen tot security-kwesties. Jij lost de storing zo efficiënt en klantvriendelijk mogelijk op! Daarbij werk je volgens de ITIL-methodiek en leg je contactmomenten vast in Autotask voor rapportage en terugkoppeling. We streven ernaar incidenten zo veel mogelijk binnen de Service Desk op te lossen, ‘first time fix’. Naast dat de gebruiker daar het meest mee geholpen is, leer je daar zelf ook veel van. Iedere klant met zijn eigen inrichting en technische uitdagingen, vraagt soms snel te schakelen en is in technisch opzicht hartstikke leerzaam. Naast dat we vanuit dit team de gebruikers zo optimaal mogelijk ondersteunen zijn we ook altijd bezig met het verbeteren van onze eigen processen. Denk aan bedrijfsuitjes, verjaardagen, vrijgezellenfeesten, borrels en zelfs bruiloften op het water. Praktisch Locatie: Kantoor in hartje Amsterdam Salaris: Tussen de €2.700 - €2.900 per maand op basis van 40 uur + jaarlijkse bonus Startdatum: In overleg Dit bieden wij 25 vakantiedagen per jaar en de mogelijkheid om 10 extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen; Bedrijfsfitness via Urban Sports; Pensioenopbouw via Brand New Day; Een gezellige werksfeer en een verzorgde lunch op ons kantoor in hartje Amsterdam; 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding; Mogelijkheid om je vaarbewijs te halen; Legendarische bedrijfsfeesten en borrels; Werken bij een award-winnend bedrijf (Tripadvisor #1 Top Overall Experience in the World) . Over Flagship Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

review_candidates.title: Product Manager, In-Person Giving
review_candidates.description: Highlights: Location: Cyprus Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+) About Fundraise Up We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver. A Truly Global Product We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe. We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals , admin tools , and several internal apps. The Team We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first. About In-Person Giving At Fundraise Up In-Person Giving brings the quality and connected data of Fundraise Up’s online donation experience into physical fundraising moments. The product begins with Tap to Donate and Giving Station: staff-led and self-service experiences that let nonprofits accept contactless donations at events, in public spaces, and through other offline workflows. Every transaction should connect to the same campaigns, donor records, reporting, CRM integrations, and operational controls used across Fundraise Up. The next product direction is Events & Commerce . It includes ticket sales, check-in, merchandise and food purchases, symbolic purchases, auctions, paddle raises, and additional donations before and during an event. These capabilities must work as one connected fundraising system rather than another isolated event tool. About The Role We are hiring a Product Manager to own Events & Commerce within the broader In-Person Giving product line. This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn a large category into a focused product direction grounded in customer workflows, live usage, and commercial evidence. You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader In-Person Giving area so that event commerce builds on the same payment, campaign, donor-data, reporting, mobile, and operational foundations as Tap to Donate and Giving Station. You will also partner with the Peer-to-Peer team where ticketing and event capabilities should be shared rather than rebuilt separately. This is not an event-planning, sales, or internal project-coordination role. What You’ll Own Define the product direction Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear Events & Commerce product thesis and sequenced roadmap. Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to replace every event platform at once. Decide which capabilities belong in the shared In-Person Giving foundation and which require an Events-specific model. Make explicit decisions about what Fundraise Up should build, integrate, partner on, or deliberately exclude. Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions visible. Lead discovery and product definition Work directly with nonprofit fundraising teams, event operators, finance teams, volunteers, attendees, donors, design partners, and internal GTM teams. Map the complete workflow before, during, and after an event—including purchase, donation, check-in, fulfillment, reconciliation, reporting, and follow-up. Validate decisions through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, and live product usage. Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and expectations created by incumbent event platforms. review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure and Data Engineer (Remote in Europe)
review_candidates.description: About the role Hyperion Quantitative Strategies is an AI-native systematic fund built end to end by its own engineering team. Kubernetes on Google Cloud, Terraform-managed infrastructure, automated pipelines pulling market data across equities, options, index options, volatility and crypto at minute and daily resolution, a proprietary backtesting engine, and a live trading book. The fund is already in discussions that would take it to several hundred million dollars in assets under management, and the ambition is a firm built in the spirit of Renaissance Technologies, with AI core to how it operates rather than a layer sitting on top. The engineering bench is deliberately small and senior. One engineer deep in backtesting and infrastructure, one in agentic systems and the data lake, one in data engineering — and the CTO owning the quantitative layer above them. This role sits across the whole platform: cloud architecture, data pipelines, production reliability and live-system ownership, in one senior individual contributor seat. Infrastructure is the floor, not the ceiling. You design the systems, you run them, and the calls about where the platform goes next are yours to make. You will report directly to the CTO and co-founder. Copenhagen is the preferred base; strong candidates in CET-compatible European time zones are considered. Hyperion is built inside the Bifrost Studios portfolio, and Bifrost Studios is running this search. What you'll do Own and evolve the Kubernetes platform on Google Cloud (GKE) through Terraform, with infrastructure as code treated as an engineering discipline rather than a collection of scripts. Build and operate the pipelines that ingest market data from multiple vendors — normalisation, validation and strict format compliance included — so the trading engine always has numbers it can rely on. Own deployment, monitoring, alerting and incident response for the live trading systems, so problems in the running book surface early and get resolved fast. Own the relational and analytical databases behind trading and research: schema design, performance, operations, and fault-tolerant, high-availability architecture where it earns its place. Steward the integrations with external data providers and broker connectivity, and treat the proprietary data as a long-term asset — a number pulled two years from now should still be safe to trade on. Cut operational toil through automation, so the platform needs progressively less manual intervention as it matures. Work directly alongside the CTO and the quant and data engineering team, acting as the clear owner the moment something breaks during market hours. Twelve months in, success looks like this: the research and quant team has stopped thinking about infrastructure because it just stays reliable. What we're looking for End-to-end production ownership. You have owned a production infrastructure and data platform somewhere reliability genuinely mattered — not a narrow slice of a large platform team, and not consuming infrastructure somebody else ran. This is the filter. It typically shows up somewhere between five and twelve years in, but we do not filter on years. Kubernetes, GCP and Terraform in production , with infrastructure as code held as an engineering discipline. A track record of building reliable, automated pipelines from messy external sources , with real familiarity with vendor quirks, corporate actions, adjustments and timezone handling. Strong Python and Java. JavaScript is welcome. Solid relational database skills across schema design, performance and operations, plus DevOps depth: CI/CD, observability, on-call practice and fault-tolerant architecture. Genuinely AI-native. You use AI coding agents as standard practice, not as something you are warming up to, and you can explain every line that ships and what it does to the system. A real interest in markets. Prior experience with trading or market data systems is a meaningful plus. A finance background is not required. Based in Copenhagen or within a CET-compatible European time zone. About Bifrost Studios Bifrost Studios builds and backs ambitious technology businesses, providing portfolio companies with the operational, engineering and sourcing infrastructure to grow with intent. Hyperion Quantitative Strategies is one of those businesses — and this search is being run directly by the Bifrost Studios team on Hyperion's behalf. If you are a senior engineer who wants full ownership of a live, consequential platform at the earliest stage where the decisions you make now are the ones it runs on for years, we would like to hear from you. Process: Intro call with the recruiter → technical deep dive with the CTO → interview with the quant and engineering team → case assessment and psychometrics → references and offer. Copenhagen, Denmark — CET-compatible European time zones considered. Full-time employee.

new_matches.description: 📍 Vejle, Denmark We’re looking for a new colleague to join us as our new IT Administrator and ensure AutoProff’s day-to-day IT is running smoothly – helping colleagues with their everyday IT needs while taking care of our devices, systems, networks and security. You’ll take ownership of IT operations at AutoProff while working closely with the AutoScout24 Employee Tech team in Munich. About the role Based at our headquarters in Vejle, Denmark , you’ll be the primary IT point of contact for AutoProff and lead IT Operations and support with a fully dedicated focus on providing an amazing IT Support experience to our employees with a human touch. It’s a broad, hands-on role covering daily IT operations and support, as well as migration projects and improvements to our IT setup. We’re always looking for better ways of doing things, so simplifying processes, automating recurring tasks and fixing issues at their root cause will also be part of the job. What you’ll be doing Lead daily IT operation activities and provide user support with incidents and change requests Administrate and support of state-of-the-art IT ecosystems (End-user devices, SaaS and on-premises applications, unified communication, meeting rooms, network equipment etc. End-to-end responsible for managing the lifecycle of every IT asset (procurement strategy, budget, device setup and decommissioning) while maintaining up to date our software & hardware asset management systems Implementing security protocols and procedures to prevent potential threats Upgrading, installing, and configuring new hardware and software to meet our objectives Performing diagnostic tests and debugging procedures to optimize computer systems Documenting processes, as well as backing up and archiving data Developing data retrieval and recovery procedures Designing and implementing efficient end-user feedback and error reporting systems Keeping up to date with advancements and best practices in IT administration Act as a primary local IT point of contact and willing to travel occasionally to other company locations. Maintain local IT stock, ensure equipment is available when needed. Some limited travel to other company locations and AutoScout24’s HQ in Munich should be expected. What we’re looking for A relevant IT education or vocational/apprenticeship background. 4+ years of experience in IT administration, support or a similar role. Solid experience with IT systems, networks, system security and IT administration. Experience supporting Windows and macOS in an enterprise environment. Experience with Jamf, Intune, Microsoft 365 and Azure AD. Knowledge of Identity & Access Management, including AD, SSO and MFA, ideally with Okta. Knowledge of network technologies including routers, VPN and Wi-Fi, ideally with Cisco. Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation. Strong problem-solving and communication skills. Fluency in Danish and English. We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across many different types of tasks and projects and comfortable working in an informal, dynamic and agile environment, and you combine a strong service mindset with the ability to take ownership and prioritise your work independently. You’re also someone who stays calm when something goes wrong, and you combine a strong service mindset with the ability to take ownership and prioritise your work independently. Why join AutoProff? At AutoProff, you’ll become part of an international company that is changing the way used cars are traded across Europe. You’ll work with colleagues across countries and functions in an environment where there is room to take ownership, share ideas and influence how we do things. We move quickly, work closely together and value people who are comfortable taking responsibility while also asking for input when needed. As part of AutoScout24 Group, we combine the pace and hands-on environment of AutoProff with the opportunities and international reach of one of Europe’s leading automotive marketplaces. Ready to join us? If this sounds like an opportunity you’d like to explore, we’d like to hear from you. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the position once we have found the right candidate. About AutoProff AutoProff was founded in Denmark in 2013 with one goal: to make B2B used-car trading simpler and more efficient through digital solutions. Today, AutoProff provides online B2B used-car trading solutions for professional car dealers across Europe, with more than 150,000 vehicles traded through our platforms annually. In August 2022, AutoScout24, one of Europe’s leading online automotive marketplaces, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. Together, we are working towards creating a fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C solution for used cars across Europe. Our ambition is simple: to be the home of B2B car trading for European car dealers.

new_matches.title: Information Technology Operations Specialist
new_matches.description: Vil du være med til at sikre stabil og sikker IT-drift i et hybridt IT-miljø – og samtidig være med til at udvikle måden, der drives IT på? Actief Hartmanns søger for Kredsløb A/S en erfaren IT Operations Specialist, der motiveres af at skabe stabilitet, struktur og høj kvalitet i den daglige IT-drift. Du får en central rolle i et hybridt setup, hvor du arbejder på tværs af hostede/on-prem miljøer og Microsoft Azure og bliver en vigtig del af arbejdet med at sikre, at IT-services fungerer stabilt og sikkert. Rollen er for dig, der både trives med den daglige drift og med at finde ud af, hvorfor tingene sker – og hvordan vi undgår, at de sker igen. Dit ansvar Du får et bredt ansvar for den tekniske drift og for løbende at styrke vores driftssetup. Du kommer blandt andet til at: Sikre stabil og sikker drift af IT-platforme på tværs af on-prem/hostede miljøer og Azure Overvåge services og håndtere driftsforstyrrelser Fejlsøge og løse komplekse tekniske problemer på 2nd/3rd line-niveau Håndtere Incident, Problem og Change Management struktureret i et ITSM/ITIL-setup Sikre hurtig genoprettelse af services og arbejde systematisk med at forebygge gentagne fejl Arbejde med backup, patching, hardening og adgangsstyring Udarbejde og vedligeholde dokumentation, runbooks og driftsprocedurer Bidrage til standardisering, automatisering og løbende forbedringer af driften Samarbejde tæt med interne kolleger, forretningen og eksterne leverandører Følge op på leverancer og SLA'er i en leverandørstyret driftsmodel Du bliver dermed ikke kun en, der holder driften kørende. Du får også mulighed for at være med til at skabe et mere standardiseret, dokumenteret og robust driftsmiljø. Vi forestiller os, at du har minimum 5 års erfaring med IT Operations eller infrastruktur og er vant til at arbejde i komplekse driftsmiljøer. Det er et krav, at du har væsentlig praktisk erfaring med Azure Infrastruktur og Azure drift/operations-opgaver. Herunder også erfaring med deployment af Azure-infrastruktur- og servicekomponenter – både via GUI og IaC. Vi forventer, at du har erfaring med: Azure Infrastruktur og Azure drift/operations IT-drift i et hybridt miljø med on-prem/hostede miljøer og Azure. Deployment af Azure-infrastruktur og servicekomponenter via både GUI og IaC. Incident, Problem og Change Management og gerne ITIL/ITSM. Overvågning, fejlsøgning og stabilitetsarbejde. Windows Server, Active Directory eller tilsvarende infrastruktur. Dokumentation, runbooks og driftsprocedurer. Arbejde med enten SQL-drift eller Endpoint Management – erfaring med begge dele er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det er desuden relevant, hvis du har erfaring med eksempelvis PowerShell, Azure CLI, Terraform eller Bicep samt Azure governance og monitoring/observability. Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er din praktiske erfaring, din tekniske forståelse og din tilgang til professionel IT-drift. Hvem er du? Du er typen, der skaber ro og overblik, når noget går galt. Du arbejder struktureret og disciplineret og ved, at god drift handler om mere end at få systemet op at køre igen – det handler også om at forstå årsagen og sikre, at problemet ikke gentager sig. Du tager ansvar og følger opgaven til dørs. Samtidig er du nysgerrig og vedholdende, når du skal finde årsagen til et problem, du ikke har mødt før. Du trives med samarbejde og kan kommunikere med både tekniske kolleger, leverandører og forretningen. Du behøver ikke være den, der fylder mest i rummet, men du er fagligt velfunderet og tør tage ansvar for dine vurderinger. Og så har du lyst til at forbedre driften løbende – hvad enten det handler om bedre dokumentation, standardisering, automatisering eller en smartere måde at håndtere incidents på. Du tilbydes Du bliver en del af et miljø, hvor stabil drift, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er i fokus. Du får en bred rolle med mulighed for at arbejde på tværs af både klassisk infrastruktur, Azure og ITSM og får samtidig mulighed for at sætte dit præg på, hvordan driften udvikler sig.

new_matches.title: Infrastructure System Engineer
new_matches.description: We're looking for a junior-to-mid systems and infrastructure engineer to take on the day-to-day operation of our Linux, AWS , and blockchain-node infrastructure . You'll start by owning routine administration and monitoring, and grow into more of our infrastructure-as-code and node-operations work over time. This is a hands-on operations role with a clear path to broader responsibility, and a great fit for someone with solid fundamentals who wants to deepen their cloud and infrastructure skills in a real production environment. What You'll Do: Operate and maintain our Linux, AWS, and blockchain-node infrastructure on a day-to-day basis. Own routine administration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of services and networking. Contribute to our infrastructure-as-code work with Terraform, growing your ownership over time. Support blockchain node operations across our ecosystem. Automate recurring tasks and diagnostics through scripting. Help keep our systems secure, patched, and running smoothly. Requirements: Must-Haves: Linux administration: CLI fluency, systemd, package management, log analysis, and troubleshooting of services and networking. Shell scripting (Bash) for automation and diagnostics. Working knowledge of core AWS services: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, and load balancers (ELB/ALB). You should be able to operate and debug them, not necessarily architect them. Terraform at a working level: you have authored and applied configurations and understand state and the plan/apply cycle. Prior Terraform experience on any cloud is fine, it doesn't need to be AWS. Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SSH, firewalls and security groups. Git: comfortable with the everyday branch/commit/PR workflow. Sound credential and access hygiene: proper SSH key handling, least-privilege IAM, keeping secrets out of code and repositories, and keeping systems patched. Cool-to-Haves: Terraform beyond the basics: modules, remote state, multi-environment setups. Blockchain node experience, whether with Cosmos specifically or another chain. Docker; Kubernetes exposure is a plus. Monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana). Python for tooling beyond Bash. CI/CD exposure. Soft Skills Accountability: you own your work and communicate openly when something goes wrong, focusing on fixing it rather than explaining it away. Honesty and candor: you speak up for what's good for the team, even when it's not the easiest thing to say. A self-taught instinct: you're comfortable figuring things out on your own and genuinely enjoy learning, since much of this role is grown into rather than known on day one. Collaborative team player, self-directed and comfortable working autonomously in remote environments.

new_matches.description: Join the Future of Security at Netskope Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram. About the position: The Netskope Channel Solutions Engineer for Germany will come on board with the full support of the executive team. This is an amazing opportunity for the sales professional who has a history of completely dominating their territory and who wants to make an impact on building the next iconic cloud security company. Responsibilities include: As a Netskope Channel Solutions Engineer you will be responsible for: Build relationships with key partner base and their SEs Own and drive technical enablement activities for key and assigned partner base Educate customers on the ongoing trends and challenges that are driving the need for cloud security and help channel understand where Netskope addresses these challenges Deliver effective demos, best practices session on UCs, deployments & workshops as needed Provide on the job training for partner SEs by allowing partner SE to shadow presentations and evaluation installations. Help partners create evaluation test plans with customers that highlight the strengths of our platform to position Netskope as the clear cloud security leader Present at channel-driven marketing activities as-needed basis. Assist in the selling effort to partner technical resources during new partner recruitment Work with channel partners to proactively expand our awareness and install base within existing accounts. Collaborates with other SEs, sales teams, and trainers Job Requirements: 7+ years of relevant experience as a Solutions/System Engineer with a proven track record and demonstrable skills at presenting technical information at the business executive level or at the architect level Proven track record using it to help drive revenue Proven hands-on experience with information security solutions such as Web Proxy, NGFW, Security Gateways, SIEMs, SAML/SSO, DLP, Data security and protection technologies such as HSM, Tokenization & encryption gateways Demonstrable experience with systems installation, configuration and administration UNIX/Linux and Windows-based systems Proficient in mobile device technologies (MDM/MAM) and OS such as Android, iOS, and Windows Mobile Knowledge of certificates, key management systems, HSM and related protocols Experience working with Active Directory Services including ADFS, working knowledge of Azure AD is desired Knowledgeable with application programming; such as REST/SOAP API’s, JSON and enterprise architectures Working knowledge of the broader threat landscape and the ability to distill technology trends, and explain complex behaviors in simple terms Education: Bachelor Degree preferred Compensation: At Netskope, salary is one component of our competitive total rewards package. The salary range for this position is as listed below, and applies to candidates based in European Union (EU) member states, in local currency. This range is provided in accordance with EU pay transparency requirements. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, location, and market conditions. For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the On Target Earnings (OTE) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target commission amount at 100% goal achievement. In addition to salary, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus plan (for non-sales roles) and a stock award program. Candidates may also be eligible for a comprehensive health plan and other benefits that can be reviewed upon request. Salary Range €115.000—€213.000 EUR Netskope is committed to implementing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment. Netskope does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on religion, race, color, sex, marital or veteran statues, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, genetic information, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations of any jurisdiction in which we operate. Netskope respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us, please refer to Netskope's Privacy Policy for more details.
